reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I noted her correction that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June, and told her I hadn't taken any action, as she asked. I also said that if she wants her #north-team post fixed, she can edit it herself or ask me to post a correction there.

A renewal date counts as account information rather than a money figure, so it was fine to repeat it in that channel. I didn't read #north-team, and I didn't need to.
